title: astracantha morganii
intro: Astracantha morganii, commonly known as Caltrop or Astragalus morganii, is a plant species in the legume family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, primarily due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Astracantha morganii involve its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
